details: For finite classes with $\mathrm{sd}(\mathcal H)\geq1$, $\mathrm{LR}(\mathcal H,\epsilon)\geq\lceil(\mathrm{sd}(\mathcal H)+3)/2\rceil$ for every $0<\epsilon<1/2$, hence $\mathrm{LR}(\mathcal H)\geq(\mathrm{sd}(\mathcal H)+3)/2$. The two-complementary-hypotheses case is excluded.
proof: This is Theorem 10 of the cited paper. Taking the limit in $\epsilon$ gives the stated affine lower bound for the list replicability number.
name: List Replicability / Spherical Dimension (affine)
